title: IDMS report layout refresh — rolling out this week
body: Alerts and Coaching reports have a new column order starting this week. No action needed — if a customer says a report "looks different," this is why.
author: Priya S. — SME

title: Confirm tenant timezone before reading alert timestamps
body: Alert timestamps are stored in the tenant's configured local timezone, not yours. Check the tenant timezone in IDMS before telling a customer an alert "happened at the wrong time."
author: Govind B. — Manager

title: One ANOPS ticket per issue, not per email
body: When a customer sends multiple follow-up emails on the same issue, keep updating the original ANOPS ticket. Duplicate tickets fragment the investigation history and slow down Analytics Engineering.
author: Govind B. — Manager

title: Driveri accessory escalations now route to Hardware Ops
body: D-Hub and VDR hardware escalations route to the Hardware Ops queue instead of general ANOPS. Use the "Hardware Ops" component when filing.
author: Priya S. — SME
